newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Safety-Kleen rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Safety-Kleen rating cut.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said Thursday it reduced its rating on Safety-Kleen Corp to 3-hold from 2-buy as it waits for evidence the company is on track for more favorable earnings comparisons.

-- Safety-Kleen reported first-quarter earnings of $11.8 million, or $0.20 a share, in line with analysts' reduced expectations, Barrington said. The company's oil recovery operations continue to be affected by weak lube oil prices after two large lubricating oil processing plants began operations in late 1996, Barrington said.
-- Barrington also reduced its 1997 earnings estimate to $1.01 a share from $1.10 and the 1998 figure to $1.20 from $1.28 to reflect the weakness in the oil recovery business.
-- Safety-Kleen shares were up 1/8 Thursday at 15.
